raw.details:
RoboForge – Open Innovation Hackathon

By E-Yantra, MSIT

Imagine it. Pitch it. Build it. Show it.

RoboForge is an open-innovation hackathon where students turn bold ideas into working prototypes. Explore innovation across Hardware & Physical Systems and Software & Intelligent Systems, with the freedom to build solutions that go beyond predefined problem statements.

Innovation Tracks:

Hardware & Physical Systems:

  • Robotics & Automation
  • IoT & Embedded Systems
  • Electronics & Hardware Innovation

Software & Intelligent Systems:

  • AI, ML & Intelligent Applications
  • Simulation, Digital Twins & Virtual Robotics
  • Software Engineering & Emerging Technologies

Bring your own idea, explore your interests, and build something innovative. Cross-track and hardware–software integrated projects are highly encouraged.

How It Works:

1. Idea Submission:

  • Register and submit a PPT outlining your idea, technical approach, and proposed prototype.

2. Shortlisting:

  • Projects will be evaluated, and selected teams will advance to the next round.

3. Build & Showcase:

  • Develop and demonstrate your working hardware prototype, software application, simulation, or integrated solution at MSIT.

Event Details:

  • Final Showcase: 16 November 2026
  • Venue: MSIT Seminar Hall – 406
  • Participation: Free

No fixed themes. Just your ideas and your innovation.

Join the official WhatsApp QnA group:  https://chat.whatsapp.com/CurzCIkvbIfHjQDCcIzAKP?s=cl&p=a&iam=2
